question: The 'Archaeological Survey of India' is headquartered in which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)** is headquartered in **New Delhi**.
 
• The ASI is an Indian government agency attached to the Ministry of Culture, responsible for archaeological research and the conservation and preservation of cultural monuments in the country.
 
• It was founded in **1861** by Alexander Cunningham who also became its first Director-General.
 
• The ASI maintains ancient monuments and archaeological sites and remains of national importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Archaeological Survey of India** was established in the year **1861** by the British Raj.
 
• The primary objective of the ASI is to explore, excavate, conserve, preserve, and protect the monuments and sites of national and international importance.
 
• The ASI also regulates the Antiquities and Art Treasures Act, 1972.
 
• It has a large collection of artifacts, sculptures, coins, and inscriptions collected from various sites across India.
 
• Besides New Delhi, ASI has several regional offices across the country.
